question: What characterizes a person who becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture?
premises: The person is motivated by greed.
The person is fickle and unstable.
Such a person becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
inference: One who seeks out of greed and remains fickle becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of capalā with an implied subject is context-dependent.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
